title: Spicy Udon Noodle Curry
description: A fusion of Indian and Southeast Asian flavors, this curry is made with soft udon noodles and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and ginger and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the coconut milk and water, and bring to a boil.
Add the udon noodles and cook, stirring constantly, until they are well coated with the curry sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with soft Thai basil.
